mapper.select: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = #{orderId} AND user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, o.merchant_id, m.name AS merchant_name, o.status, o.order_time, o.payment_time, o.total_amount, o.paid_amount, o.delivery_address_snapshot AS delivery_address, o.recipient_phone_snapshot AS recipient_phone, o.reminder_count, o.last_reminder_time, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(od.quantity), 0) FROM order_detail od WHERE od.order_id = o.id) AS item_count FROM orders o JOIN merchant m ON m.id = o.merchant_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = #{status}
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = 'PENDING_ACCEPT', payment_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{orderId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT'
UPDATE orders SET status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE id = #{orderId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT'

UPDATE orders SET reminder_count = reminder_count + 1, last_reminder_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{orderId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('PENDING_ACCEPT', 'PREPARING') AND (last_reminder_time IS NULL OR last_reminder_time <= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE))
